items.title: Free Baroque Scroll Medallion DXF Panel for CNC Double Doors
items.description: An elaborate scrollwork frame curls around a layered circular medallion built from a Greek key ring, a floral wreath, and a four-petal cross at its core. The heavy corner ornamentation tapers into open negative space near the middle edges, giving the eye a clear resting point on the medallion itself.

items.title: Overlapping Leaf Canopy DXF Panel for Lush Botanical Screens
items.description: Dense, overlapping leaf shapes fill the entire panel edge to edge like a thick garden canopy, with no visible background gaps. The lush, all-over botanical texture suits garden screens, balcony infill, and nature-themed doors.
